title: PathRIR: Physics-Guided Acoustic Path Selection and Late-Tail Compensation for Fast Room Impulse Response Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2607.23293v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Image-source-method (ISM)-based room impulse response (RIR) simulation is a useful and physically interpretable tool for acoustic scene modeling, but full-order ISM becomes computationally expensive as the reflection order and room complexity increase. We propose a physics-guided framework for fast RIR simulation that preserves the geometric structure of ISM while learning to retain only acoustically important image-source paths during online traversal. To recover energy removed by pruning, the proposed PathRIR uses a lightweight compensation multilayer perceptron to predict the missing late-tail energy envelope and generate a compensation tail whose energy follows that envelope. translated_title: PathRIR：物理引导的声学路径选择与晚期尾部补偿，用于快速房间脉冲响应模拟
translated_abstract: 基于镜像源法（ISM）的房间脉冲响应（RIR）模拟是一种有用且物理可解释的声学场景建模工具，但随着反射阶数和房间复杂度的增加，全阶ISM的计算成本变得昂贵。我们提出了一种物理引导的快速RIR模拟框架，该框架保留了ISM的几何结构，同时学习在在线遍历过程中仅保留声学上重要的镜像源路径。为了恢复剪枝移除的能量，所提出的PathRIR使用一个轻量级补偿多层感知器来预测缺失的晚期尾部能量包络，并生成一个遵循该包络的补偿尾部。在非规则三维房间上的实验表明，与全阶ISM模拟器相比，PathRIR减少了镜像源计算并提高了运行效率，同时实现了低波形和衰减相关误差。消融结果显示，添加补偿尾部显著改善了晚期混响的保真度。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种物理引导的快速RIR模拟框架，通过剪枝不重要的镜像源路径并利用轻量级补偿网络预测晚期尾部能量，在保持物理可解释性的同时显著提升计算效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a physics-guided fast RIR simulation framework that prunes unimportant image-source paths and uses a lightweight compensation network to predict late-tail energy, significantly improving computational efficiency while maintaining physical interpretability.
